title: Learning science vocab
description: Key terms from cognitive science that help you study smarter.

cards.back: Mixing related topics or problem types in one session instead of blocking a single type.
A challenge that slows performance now but improves long-term learning.
The process of forming a memory when you first engage with material under attention.
Stabilizing a memory after learning, often supported by sleep.
Judging what you know — often overconfident if you only re-read smoothly.
Trying to produce an answer from memory before checking the source.
